title: fix(cli): report the selected Codex harness model
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16350

- Reports the requested and smoke-verified model in Codex enable's result instead of the first model retained by additive curation.
- Preserves standalone status, child-key reuse, setup, smoke verification, and rollback behavior.
- Extends the existing override test for a newly curated model, repeated selection of a non-first model, and unchanged status. One regression fails before the fix; all nine focused tests and 280 CLI tests pass afterward.
- Verification: build, Biome, independent focused review and diff checks pass. Strict TypeScript retains main's 36 diagnostics; tests use installed Vitest 2.1.9 and synthetic router fixtures. No live model calls or Pollen used.

gist.headline: The chosen model gets named
gist.blurb: Codex enable reports the model it actually selected, even when that model isn’t first on the curated list. A small but useful distinction.
gist.summary: The Polli CLI’s Codex enable result reports the requested, smoke-verified model instead of the first model retained by additive curation, without changing setup, status, child-key reuse, verification, or rollback behavior.
gist.impact: CLI users see the model they selected in the Codex enable result, including when they choose a non-first curated model.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy CLI terminal with a short curated model list: the selected non-first entry and the result line point to the same model. Polli, wearing tiny coder glasses, checks the result beside a small code-plant; the focus is accurate reporting, not a new model.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, a retro terminal shows a short model list with its second entry highlighted and a matching result line, while a small Polli in tiny coder glasses points approvingly at the screen beside a sprouting code-plant. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, with consistent rounded proportions, strictly pixel art and never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow, warm cream and pastel surroundings, dark purple (#110518) outlines, chunky sprites, and a nostalgic, emotionally warm feel.
